
{{alias}}( t, y, p )
    Computes the squared hinge loss.

    If any argument is `NaN`, the function returns `NaN`.

    If `y` is not +1 or -1, the function returns `NaN`.

    When `t = 1.0`, we get the loss used by SVM.

    Parameters
    ----------
    t: number
        Margin threshold.

    y: number
        True target value.

    p: number
        Predicted value.

    Returns
    -------
    v: number
        Squared hinge loss.

    Examples
    --------
    > var v = {{alias}}( 1.0, 1.0, 0.782 )
    ~0.0475
    > v = {{alias}}( 1.0, 1.0, 0.202 )
    ~0.6368
    > v = {{alias}}( 1.0, 1.0, -0.999 )
    ~3.996
    > v = {{alias}}( 1.0, -1.0, 0.2 )
    1.44
    > v = {{alias}}( 1.0, 1.0, NaN )
    NaN

    See Also
    --------
